description: Hash and licensing contract for externally downloaded Anime4K shader components used by fixed-machine certification.

measurementNormalizer.activationRule: The fixed runner must hash and execute an approved normalizer from its configured absolute path. The normalizer must regenerate this index from raw artifacts in a fresh output file; imported indexes and manifest samples are never trusted.

strictEvidenceBundle.certificationRule: Only Anime4K may be certified. Exactly one performance, balanced, and quality manifest form a matrix. Every preset is evaluated independently and the matrix passes only when all three pass. Timed windows must keep requested and effective provider/profile/shader hashes equal with no fallback. Raw traces, captures, telemetry, and derived measurements may not be shared across scenario IDs.

activation: A dedicated performance-policy change must pin every required version, byte size, SHA-256, license, playback asset, and the exact measurement-normalizer executable before strict upscaling can be routed.
